delete.title: Delete template?
delete.text: “{name}” will be deleted. A linked template in Raid-Helper stays.

editor.more: More: appearance, melee/ranged, required buffs, signup deadline, duration, waiting list, Raid-Helper template
editor.fairnessTip: Whoever sat on the bench last time is preferred in the setup suggestion.
editor.wishesTip: “Likes to raid with” from the profiles feeds into the setup suggestion.
editor.overflowTip: Once the raid is full, every new signup that takes a spot (“Signed up” and “Late”) goes to the bench. Off: the signup is refused.
editor.lockAtLimitTip: As soon as all spots are taken, signups close. Signing off does not reopen them.

page.title: Raid templates
page.importSub: Takes over the Raid-Helper templates of the current events as templates without a size.
page.emptyVersion: No template for this game version.
